List of Contestants and Statistics[]

This is a complete list of Big Brother (US) contestants from the main series. Here will also be stated each contestants' competition standings and votes against. Take note that the ages and hometowns stated in this table are the contestants' age and residence as of the first day of filming. Only Head of Household (including reigns that were eventually dethroned) and Power of Veto competitions will be considered in the "Competition Statistics" column (excluding HOH and/or POVs not won in a competition), while the "Votes Against" column will also include votes that are negated, penalty votes incurred due to rule violations, and those cast by the Head of Household, if tied. Jury votes are excluded from the table. As of Big Brother 27 (US), a total of 353 people have participated across every season.

Second Appearance Third Appearance Fourth Appearance
Italics denote this houseguest has passed away
Some seasons had a different format or special twists:

• Big Brother 1 did not have eviction votes, but did have nominations received from other players, so that is what will be shown in those columns.
• Big Brother 1 and 2 did not have POV competitions, and Big Brother 1 also did not have HOH competitions, so those columns will state N/A for the respective houseguests.
• Big Brother 5 and 17 featured twin houseguests who spent time in the game pretending to be one player, before eventually entering the games themselves. Their time in the house is still counted as if they were in the game from Day 1.
• Big Brother 9 featured the first few evictions happening in pairs, so certain players are tied in the highest possible placement based on when they left the house together.
• Many seasons featured Battle Back twists, and in those cases only days spent in the Big Brother house are counted for those players. That includes days spent in the house while evicted in Camp Comeback during Big Brother 21 or as a BB Zombie during Big Brother 25.
